title: 국회 입법예고에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1

Article 4 (Period of Prior Announcement of Legislation, etc.)
(1) The chairperson shall determine the period of prior announcement of legislation when making the announcement. The period shall be at least 10 days for a bill partially amending an Act and at least 15 days for a bill enacting an Act or wholly amending an Act: Provided, That the chairperson may shorten the period in consultation with the executive secretaries where special circumstances exist.
(2) Where special circumstances exist with respect to a bill during its prior announcement period under paragraph (1), the chairperson may shorten the period in consultation with the executive secretaries. Where necessary for examining the bill, the chairperson may extend the period in consultation with the executive secretaries.
(3) Where the chairperson considers that a reason for not making a prior announcement of legislation under any of the subparagraphs of Article 82-2 (1) of the Act no longer exists, the chairperson may, in consultation with the executive secretaries, make a prior announcement of legislation for the relevant bill.
